tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: ESTABLISHED. Primary brand color: hero backgrounds, the organizer exterior, mascot fill. Text on it is always ink (7.1:1), never white (2.4:1 fails).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: ESTABLISHED. High-energy accent: primary buttons, zipper pull, small playful details. Text on it is always ink (6.1:1), never white (2.7:1 fails). Never used to mean a warning.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: ESTABLISHED. Deep plum: headlines, body text, icons, strong contrast. 15.4:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: ESTABLISHED. Secondary copy and captions. 5.7:1 on surface, 5.3:1 on surface-tint.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: ESTABLISHED. Soft off-white: page background, guidebook paper.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: ESTABLISHED. Pale lavender: cards, callouts, sections that need gentle separation.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: ESTABLISHED. Dividers and decorative borders only (1.2:1 is too faint for input or control outlines; use ink for those).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: ESTABLISHED. Raised panels and step cards on surface.

tokens.name: lavender-ink
tokens.usage: NEW. Deeper lavender for links, small icons and lavender text on light grounds (6.0:1), where brand lavender is too light (2.2:1).

tokens.name: orange-ink
tokens.usage: NEW. Deeper orange for orange text or small accents on light grounds (5.1:1); also takes white text (5.6:1).

tokens.name: status-stop
tokens.usage: NEW, needs testing. Dashboard 'red light' group: stop safely and get help. Always paired with a label and the octagon shape; white text 5.6:1.

tokens.name: status-soon
tokens.usage: NEW, needs testing. Dashboard 'amber light' group: check soon. Ink text only (9.2:1). Paired with a label and the triangle shape. Distinct from brand orange so warnings never look like decoration.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: NEW, needs testing. Dashboard 'green/blue light' group: a system is on, no action. White text 5.1:1. Paired with a label and the circle shape.
